For the first run, load only Active records from IF_MASTER_DATA.ITEM_IF_ANALYSIS.INTELFOUNDRY_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_PLANT_ITEM_PARENT_ASSOCIATION  where SOURCE_DELETE_IND is Blank and DELETE_IND = FALSE to IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM_BASE.T_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_ROOT. Set ACTIVE_IND = TRUE.
Another filter to be added-> Effective_end_date ='31-12-9999' (open end date)

In Subsequent runs, check the status of record in root table and update ACTIVE_IND based on below logic.
1. Set ACTIVE_IND = TRUE, If SOURCE_DELETE_IND is Blank and DELETE_IND = FALSE, this record is active in both ROO and ROR. In PDH, we should consider this as an active record.
2. Set ACTIVE_IND=FALSE, If SOURCE_DELETE_IND is Blank and DELETE_IND = TRUE, this active record is physically deleted in ROO (under normal circumstance, it should not happen if the source table has soft-deletion indicator) In PDH, we should consider this as an inactive record.
3. Set ACTIVE_IND=FALSE, If SOURCE_DELETE_IND is X and DELETE_IND = FALSE, this record was soft deleted in the ROO but still considered as a valid record in ROR, in case DSA needs to know a record is now inactivated in ROO. In PDH, we should either ignore this record or mark it as inactive.
4. Set ACTIVE_IND=FALSE, If SOURCE_DELETE_IND is X and DELETE_IND = TRUE, this record was soft deleted in the ROO, and later it was hard deleted from the source object. In PDH, we should either ignore this record or mark it as inactive.

blocks.text:
> We need to remove the leading zeros from the PARENT_ITEM_ID and COMPONENT_ITEM_ID. For example, if ITEM_ID = 0000010000007, it should be stored as ITEM_ID = 10000007. This does not apply to the Dummy Item derived in the PDH layer.

> We need to map the dummy item for specific item classes that serve as COMPONENT_ITEM_ID when no relevant further mapping is found in the source data. 
1. For this we need validate if the Substrate item doesnt have a valid COMPONENT_ITEM_ID then, create dummy component as follows: 
This mapping can be done using metadata with the following criteria: SUBJECT_AREA_NM = 'Bom', ENTITY_NM = 'Item', and BUSINESS_RULE_NM = 'DummyItem'. The COLUMN_VALUE_FOUR_TXT field contains the ITEM_CLASS_NM information, which should be mapped to the PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM and COLUMN_VALUE_SIX_TXT as USAGE_PROBABILITY_PCT, COLUMN_VALUE_SEVEN_TXT as COMPONENT_QTY,COLUMN_VALUE_NINE_TXT as CO_PRODUCT_IND, COLUMN_VALUE_TEN_TXT as PLANT_CD, COLUMN_VALUE_ELEVEN_TXT as BILL_OF_MATERIAL_ITEM_NBR,COLUMN_VALUE_EIGHT_TXT as SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM.
2. IF there is valid COMPONENT_ITEM_ID for a substrate Item, then dont create a dummy.
3. Add a DQ in the second case, that if DESIGNED_FUNCTION_CD (look up in characteristic denormalized core pit)  = EMB, then there should be a component, else it needs to be flagged.
4. Irrespective of whether a substrate (as PARENT) has a component or not, the PARENT_ITEM_PLANT_CD for Substrate classes should always be 'VF_S'.

> To have a BOM for FAB items, we need to have F_FAB item as PARENT_ITEM_ID, but from source we are not getting mapping for F_FAB-SILICON_WAFER. 
1. To have a BOM created, we will be using DUMMY item as COMPONENT_ITEM_ID to F_FAB item as PARENT_ITEM_ID, as mentioned in above step. 
2. Get all F_FAB items where there is no component_item_id.
3. Join with V_BRD_ITEM_LOCATION_CORE_PIT, get all PLANT_CD where ITEM_ID = F_FAB item id.
4. Use  metadata with the following criteria: SUBJECT_AREA_NM = 'Bom', ENTITY_NM = 'Item', and BUSINESS_RULE_NM = 'DummyItem'. The COLUMN_VALUE_FOUR_TXT field contains the ITEM_CLASS_NM information, which should be mapped to the PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM and COLUMN_VALUE_SIX_TXT as USAGE_PROBABILITY_PCT, COLUMN_VALUE_SEVEN_TXT as COMPONENT_QTY,COLUMN_VALUE_NINE_TXT as CO_PRODUCT_IND,  COLUMN_VALUE_ELEVEN_TXT as BILL_OF_MATERIAL_ITEM_NBR,COLUMN_VALUE_EIGHT_TXT as SOURCE_SYSTEM_NM.
5. IF there is valid COMPONENT_ITEM_ID for a F_FAB Item, then dont create a dummy.
6. BOM is also required for ITEM ORDER POINT = Y FAB items.

> Populate the BILL_OF_MATERIAL_NBR, USAGE_PROBABILITY_PCT and COMPONENT_QTY from the metadata for the Substrates to Dummy Item BOM.
>Have a check before adding a dummy BOM->  for UNBW items we wont create any dummy. MATERIAL_TYPE_CD = UNBW from ITEM view.

>. Master BOM records are generated using concept of an 'Anchor' item. Generally the anchor item will the parent (output) item.
Rule1: PARENT_ITEM_ID will be AnchorItemId in most of the cases (Thumb rule)
Rule2: COMPONENT_ITEM_ID will be the AnchorItemId, i.e.when we have matching COMPONENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM, PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM with characteristic configured in metadata (Co-product Enable)
Rule3: PARENT_ITEM_ID will be the AnchorItemId,i.e. when we have matching COMPONENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM, PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM with characteristic configured in metadata (Co-Product Disable)

blocks.text:
A unique BOM_HASH will be assigned to each COMPONENT_ITEM_ID,PARENT_ITEM_ID & PLANT_CD combination by concatenating the COMPONENT_ITEM_ID,PARENT_ITEM_ID,BOM_ID with the BOM ID series beginning at 0 and incrementing sequentially. By this way we can ensure the BOM stickiness.
Generate hash key for this. (this is just for internal consumption. not to send to BY. Uniquely identify the data).

 > Master BOM_ID Generation Logic: Distinct ANCHOR_ITEM_ID, ANCHOR_ITEM_CLASS_NM, PARENT_ITEM_ID is used to create distinct BOM_ID's
1. For all the PARENT_ITEM_ID which belongs to the class 'F_TEST' or 'F_DIE_PREP' generate the PDH BOM ID based on the corresponding Anchor Item (COMPONENT_ITEM_ID) which belongs to the class  'F_ASSEMBLY',  'F_SORT' respectively. (Co Product stages)
2. For all the COMPONENT_ITEM_ID which belongs to the class  'F_TEST' generate the PDH BOM ID based on the corresponding Anchor Item (PARENT_ITEM_ID) which belongs to the class  'F_FINISH'.
3. For rest of the FAB,BUMP,SORT, WLA and Silicon Wafer items generate the PDH BOM_ID based on Anchor Item (PARENT_ITEM_ID).

> For PROC BOM Generation:
1. For all ASSEMBLY-to-TEST links, to get the TEST_PROC items
> Get the Parent items where PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM ='F_PROC_TEST' and get the corresponding Component item  where the CO_PRODUCT_IND='N' in IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_ROOT.

2. For all SORT-to-DIE_PREP links, to get the DIE_PREP_PROC items
> Get the Parent items where PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM ='F_PROC_DIE_PREP' and get the corresponding Component item  where the CO_PRODUCT_IND='N' in IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_ROOT.

3. For all WLA links, to get the STACK_SI_PROC items
> Get the Parent items where PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM ='F_PROC_STACK_SI' and get the corresponding Component item  where the CO_PRODUCT_IND='N' in IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_BRD_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_ROOT.

4. For all TEST-to-FINISH links, to get the FINISH_PROC items 
> Get the Parent items where PARENT_ITEM_CLASS_NM ='F_PROC_FINISH'. 
> To map F_PROC_FINISH to F_PROC_TEST one - one based on Assembly item, we need to identify the same using PROC_IDENTIFIER which is ASSEMBLY item id.
> Both the TEST_PROC and FINISH_PROC items will have the same ASSEMBLY item as value in IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_CHARACTERISTIC_DENORMALIZED_CORE_PIT for the Characterisitc column name  'PROC_IDENTIFIER' which is the COMPONENT_ITEM_ID.
For defining the PRIMARY_ALTERNATE_CD for PROC/ UPI items :

> For each PARENT_ITEM_ID at the UPI level we will rely on the 'USAGE_PROBABILITY_PCT' column to determine which COMPONENT_ITEM_ID has the maximum value. The entry with the highest value will be marked as ‘Primary,’ while the others will be treated as ‘Alternate’.
> If the  'USAGE_PROBABILITY_PCT' column values are identical across all COMPONENT_ITEM_ID, then there are no alternates, and all entries should be considered as ‘Primary.’ (should be not null).
> In case multiplel USAGE PROBABILITY PCT are same, pick any one.

     A. If there is a PROC_ITEM_ID mapped to it then pass that PROC_ITEM_ID in the BOM view as PARENT_ITEM_ID and bring the corresponding BOM entry to the HYBRID_CORE_PIT view.

Excluding Pseduo classes and connecting assembly directly to typeA and typeB
Use a recursive approach with the BOM traversal view to filter out unnecessary item classes when mapping Substrate items to F_ASSEMBLY items based on metadata. Begin from ITEM_CLASS_NM ='SUB_CORE' (Component) and skip item classes until ITEM_CLASS_NM = 'F_ASSEMBLY' (Parent) is reached. BLL_OF_MATERIAL_ID will be based on ANCHOR_ITEM_ID which will be in this case F_ASSEMBLY.
